title: Tech Firms, Govts. Clash For Capital: Market Snapshot
title_cn: 科技公司、政府。资本冲突：市场概况
summary:
As the AI buildout relies more heavily on credit and equity financing, access to capital is emerging as an another more acute pain point for the AI trade. Hyperscalers alongside specialized AI ventures are flooding credit markets with record amounts of new debt to pay for power-hungry data centers, chips, and energy grids. At the same time, governments, led by the US, facing skyrocketing budget deficits, rising defense budgets, and higher term premiums are issuing record volumes of sovereign debt. Traders are now making space in their portfolios for corporate bonds offering far higher yields on AI debt as a wave of potential mega-IPOs from OpenAI and Anthropic approach.
 (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Lipsky: China Could Limit Trump's Iran Pressure
title_cn: 利普斯基：中国可以限制特朗普对伊朗的压力
summary: Josh Lipsky, Vice President of International Economics at the Atlantic Council, says Beijing is betting President Donald Trump wants to make a "big show" of economic pressure on Iran but will stop short of squeezing Chinese banks. Lipsky also says the US is testing investors' patience in a way it hasn't for a long time as debt tops $40 trillion. Lipsky also weighs in on ongoing US-Canada tariff negotiations. He speaks with Kailey Leinz on the late edition of Bloomberg's "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Lawler Calls For More Pressure On China Over Iran Oil
title_cn: 劳勒呼吁就伊朗石油问题向中国施加更大压力
summary: Republican Rep. Mike Lawler of New York says the US should "hold the Chinese to account" for facilitating Iran's illicit oil trade as President Donald Trump pushes an economic "D-Day" against Tehran. Lawler, a member of the House Foreign Affairs and Financial Services committees, also calls the $40 trillion US debt a "crisis" and says Congress needs a bipartisan solution. He speaks with Kailey Leinz on the late edition of Bloomberg's "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)
